target.content: def verify_bundle(output_dir, render=None):     """Return a list of problems found in a standalone output directory.     Only local files are read. ``render`` optionally re-renders report.md from the     machine bundle (the packaged ``render_markdown_report``) for an exact comparison.     """     out = Path(output_dir)     problems = []     def bad(code, message):         problems.append(f"{code}: {message}")     try:         bundle = json.loads((out / "bundle.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))     except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:         return [f"E_BUNDLE: bundle.json unreadable ({error})"]     if bundle.get("schema_version") != BUNDLE_SCHEMA:         bad("E_BUNDLE", f"schema_version {bundle.get('schema_version')!r}")     operation = bundle.get("operation_id")     outcomes = bundle.get("outcomes")     if not isinstance(operation, str) or not isinstance(outcomes, list) or not outcomes:         return problems + ["E_BUNDLE: missing operation_id or outcomes"]     try:         lines = [json.loads(line) for line in (out / "outcomes.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]     except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:         lines = None         bad("E_JSONL", f"outcomes.jsonl unreadable ({error})")     expected_lines = [         {"schema_version": bundle.get("schema_version"), "operation_id": operation, "outcome": o}         for o in outcomes     ]     if lines is not None and lines != expected_lines:         bad("E_JSONL", "outcomes.jsonl does not equal the bundle outcomes")     try:         report = (out / "report.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")     except OSError as error:         report = ""         bad("E_REPORT", f"report.md unreadable ({error})")     if f"`{operation}`" not in report:         bad("E_REPORT", "report.md does not carry the bundle operation id")     if render is not None and report != render(bundle):         bad("E_REPORT", "report.md differs from a fresh render of bundle.json")     keys = [o.get("key") for o in outcomes]     if len(set(keys)) != len(keys):         bad("E_LINEAGE", "duplicate outcome keys")     store = out / "source-artifacts"     for index, outcome in enumerate(outcomes):         where = f"outcomes[{index}] ({outcome.get('key')})"         occurrence = f"input-{index}"         status = outcome.get("status")         if status not in TERMINAL:             bad("E_OUTCOME", f"{where}: status {status!r}")             continue         if f"## {outcome.get('key')} — {status}" not in report:             bad("E_REPORT", f"{where}: no report section for this outcome")         if outcome.get("disposition") != "unreviewed":             bad("E_OUTCOME", f"{where}: disposition must stay unreviewed")         observed = (outcome.get("links") or []) + (outcome.get("candidates") or []) + (outcome.get("observations") or [])         if status != "success":             # An error is never an empty success: it keeps a diagnostic and no content.             if not (outcome.get("diagnostic") or {}).get("code"):                 bad("E_ERROR_EMPTY", f"{where}: {status} without a diagnostic code")             if outcome.get("text") or observed:                 bad("E_ERROR_EMPTY", f"{where}: {status} carries extracted content")             if outcome.get("source_reference") is not None:                 bad("E_ERROR_EMPTY", f"{where}: {status} carries an unvalidated source reference")             continue         if outcome.get("diagnostic") is not None:             bad("E_ERROR_EMPTY", f"{where}: success carries a diagnostic")         reference = outcome.get("source_reference")         if not reference or not reference.get("source_proof") or not reference.get("artifact"):             bad("E_SOURCE_PROOF_MISSING", f"{where}: success without source proof")             continue         artifact = reference["artifact"]         digest = artifact.get("content_digest", "")         snapshot = artifact.get("snapshot_id", "")         # Both become path components; reject anything that is not a plain hex id.         if not (isinstance(digest, str) and SHA256_HEX.fullmatch(digest)                 and isinstance(snapshot, str) and HEX_ID.fullmatch(snapshot)):             bad("E_SOURCE_DIGEST", f"{where}: malformed content_digest/snapshot_id")             continue         body_path = store / "objects" / digest[:2] / f"{digest}.body"         try:             body = body_path.read_bytes()         except OSError:             bad("E_SOURCE_PROOF_MISSING", f"{where}: retained body {body_path.relative_to(out)} is missing")             continue         if sha256(body) != digest or len(body) != artifact.get("byte_length"):             bad("E_SOURCE_DIGEST", f"{where}: retained body does not match its digest/length")             continue         proof = _decode_proof(reference["source_proof"])         if proof is None:             bad("E_SOURCE_PROOF_MISSING", f"{where}: source proof cannot be decoded")             continue         context = proof.get("context") or {}         expec ... symbols.name: _decode_proof
symbols.content: def _decode_proof(token):     try:         prefix, body = token.split(".", 1)[0], token.split(".")[1]         if prefix != "sp1":             return None         return json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(body + "=" * (-len(body) % 4)))     except (ValueError, IndexError, binascii.Error, json.JSONDecodeError):         return None
